UPDATE req_difference SET deleted=1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(project_code,'') project_code,COALESCE(project_name,'') project_name FROM req_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE req_difference SET review_status='评审中',review_comment=NULL,review_report_name=#{report},workflow_instance_id=#{instanceId},updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE req_difference SET review_status='待评审',review_comment=#{reason},workflow_instance_id=NULL,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,display_name FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE req_difference SET current_handler_user_id=#{userId},current_handler_user_name=#{userName},updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM wf_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND business_key=#{businessKey} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status='COMPLETED',comment='差异评审撤回重提' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND instance_id=#{instanceId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE wf_instance SET status='TERMINATED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{instanceId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PENDING')
UPDATE req_difference SET workflow_instance_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,username,display_name FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND status=1 ORDER BY id

SELECT id,username,display_name,org_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status=1 AND deleted=0 AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY display_name,id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM wf_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND code=#{code} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND deleted=0

SELECT a.id,a.action_code,a.operator_id,u.display_name operator_name,a.target_user_id,tu.display_name target_user_name,a.comment,a.created_at,t.task_type,t.assignee_name,t.status task_status,t.node_id FROM wf_task_action a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.operator_id AND u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id=a.target_user_id AND tu.tenant_id=a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN wf_task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.instance_id=#{instanceId} ORDER BY a.created_at,a.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_system WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{systemId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq_no),0) FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
